_comment: Quests tools/research/quest_insert.py never adds automatically, with the reason. Our own review; extend it when a pick turns out not to be leveling content.

ClassicEra.9664: Establishing New Outposts: Scourge Invasion world event (patch 1.11), not a leveling quest
ClassicEra.9665: Bolstering Our Defenses: Scourge Invasion world event
ClassicEra.5503: Argent Dawn Commission: equips the reputation trinket, almost no XP
ClassicEra.2438: The Emerald Dreamcatcher: prerequisite of Ferocitas the Dream Eater, which the Teldrassil route already takes earlier
ClassicEra.843: Gann's Reclamation: at its pickup point the Orc routes' Barrens quest log would exceed 20
ClassicEra.868: Egg Hunt: picked up at the first Crossroads visit but finished much later; it would hold a quest-log slot through the Barrens' fullest stretch
